clueEn: A large domesticated animal that provides milk and moos.
instructionEs: Un animal domesticado grande que da leche y muge.
explanationEn: A cow is a common farm mammal that moos and gives milk.
explanationEs: Una vaca es un mamífero de granja común que muge y produce leche.

clueEn: A small furry animal with whiskers that likes to chase mice.
instructionEs: Un animal pequeño con pelaje y bigotes que persigue ratones.
explanationEn: A cat is a popular domestic feline.
explanationEs: Un gato es un felino doméstico popular.

clueEn: Man's best friend that barks and wags its tail.
instructionEs: El mejor amigo del hombre que ladra y mueve la cola.
explanationEn: Dogs are faithful domesticated canines.
explanationEs: Los perros son cánidos domésticos fieles.

clueEn: A flying animal with feathers and wings.
instructionEs: Un animal volador con plumas y alas.
explanationEn: Birds have wings and feathers.
explanationEs: Las aves tienen alas y plumas.

clueEn: A creature that lives in water and breathes with gills.
instructionEs: Una criatura que vive en el agua y respira por branquias.
explanationEn: Fish are aquatic vertebrates.
explanationEs: Los peces son vertebrados acuáticos.

clueEn: A large animal that humans ride, known for galloping.
instructionEs: Un animal grande que montan las personas, conocido por galopar.
explanationEn: Horses are equines used for riding and transport.
explanationEs: Los caballos son equinos usados para montar.

clueEn: An animal that produces wool on a farm.
instructionEs: Un animal que produce lana en una granja.
explanationEn: Sheep provide natural wool.
explanationEs: Las ovejas proporcionan lana natural.

clueEn: A farm bird kept for its eggs and meat.
instructionEs: Un ave de granja criada por sus huevos y carne.
explanationEn: Chickens are widely raised poultry.
explanationEs: Los pollos son aves de corral muy criadas.

clueEn: A tiny rodent with a long thin tail.
instructionEs: Un pequeño roedor con una cola larga y delgada.
explanationEn: Mice are small rodents.
explanationEs: Los ratones son roedores pequeños.

clueEn: A long reptile with no legs that slithers.
instructionEs: Un reptil largo sin patas que se desliza.
explanationEn: Snakes are legless reptiles.
explanationEs: Las serpientes son reptiles sin patas.

clueEn: A water bird with webbed feet that quacks.
instructionEs: Un ave acuática con patas palmeadas que hace cuac.
explanationEn: Ducks make a distinctive quack sound.
explanationEs: Los patos hacen el sonido característico de cuac.

clueEn: A furry creature with long ears that hops and loves carrots.
instructionEs: Una criatura peluda con orejas largas que salta y come zanahorias.
explanationEn: Rabbits are hopping herbivores with long ears.
explanationEs: Los conejos son herbívoros saltadores con orejas largas.

clueEn: A huge gray wild animal with a trunk and tusks.
instructionEs: Un enorme animal salvaje gris con trompa y colmillos.
explanationEn: Elephants are the largest land animals.
explanationEs: Los elefantes son los animales terrestres más grandes.

clueEn: The king of the jungle with a grand mane.
instructionEs: El rey de la selva con una gran melena.
explanationEn: Lions are big cats known for their pride.
explanationEs: Los leones son grandes felinos conocidos por su manada.

clueEn: A striped big cat that lives in Asia.
instructionEs: Un gran felino rayado que vive en Asia.
explanationEn: Tigers have distinctive orange and black stripes.
explanationEs: Los tigres tienen rayas anaranjadas y negras características.

clueEn: A tall African animal with an extremely long neck.
instructionEs: Un animal africano alto con un cuello extremadamente largo.
explanationEn: Giraffes have long necks to reach high leaves.
explanationEs: Las jirafas tienen cuellos largos para alcanzar hojas altas.

clueEn: An African wild horse with black and white stripes.
instructionEs: Un caballo salvaje africano con rayas blancas y negras.
explanationEn: Zebras are famed for black and white striped coats.
explanationEs: Las cebras son famosas por sus rayas blancas y negras.

clueEn: A large heavy mammal with thick fur that often hibernates.
instructionEs: Un mamífero grande y pesado con pelaje grueso que suele hibernar.
explanationEn: Bears are large omnivorous mammals.
explanationEs: Los osos son grandes mamíferos omnívoros.

clueEn: A canine predator that lives and hunts in a pack.
instructionEs: Un depredador canino que vive y caza en manada.
explanationEn: Wolves hunt together in packs.
explanationEs: Los lobos cazan juntos en manadas.

clueEn: A clever small mammal with bushy tail and reddish fur.
instructionEs: Un mamífero pequeño e inteligente con cola tupida y pelaje rojizo.
explanationEn: Foxes are known for their cunning nature.
explanationEs: Los zorros son conocidos por su naturaleza astuta.

clueEn: A female parent.
instructionEs: Una madre.
explanationEn: Mother refers to a female parent.
explanationEs: Mother se refiere a la madre biológica o adoptiva.

clueEn: A male parent.
instructionEs: Un padre.
explanationEn: Father is the male parent.
explanationEs: Father significa padre.

clueEn: A boy or man who shares the same parents with you.
instructionEs: Un hermano.
explanationEn: Brother is a male sibling.
explanationEs: Brother significa hermano.

clueEn: A girl or woman who shares the same parents with you.
instructionEs: Una hermana.
explanationEn: Sister is a female sibling.
explanationEs: Sister significa hermana.

clueEn: The primary color of ripe tomatoes and strawberries.
instructionEs: El color de los tomates maduros y fresas.
explanationEn: Red is the color of tomatoes.
explanationEs: Red significa rojo.

clueEn: The color of the clear daytime sky and the ocean.
instructionEs: El color del cielo despejado de día y del mar.
explanationEn: Blue is the color of clear sky.
explanationEs: Blue significa azul.

clueEn: The color of fresh grass and tree leaves.
instructionEs: El color de la hierba fresca.
explanationEn: Green represents fresh foliage.
explanationEs: Green significa verde.

clueEn: The bright color of the sun and ripe bananas.
instructionEs: El color brillante del sol y las bananas maduras.
explanationEn: Yellow is the bright color of bananas.
explanationEs: Yellow significa amarillo.

clueEn: A round sweet fruit with red, green, or yellow skin.
instructionEs: Una fruta redonda dulce de piel roja o verde.
explanationEn: An apple is a firm round fruit.
explanationEs: Apple significa manzana.

clueEn: A staple baked food made from flour, water, and yeast.
instructionEs: Un alimento horneado básico hecho con harina y agua.
explanationEn: Bread is a common bakery staple.
explanationEs: Bread significa pan.

clueEn: A clear, colorless liquid essential for all life.
instructionEs: Líquido transparente esencial para la vida.
explanationEn: Water is the vital clear liquid.
explanationEs: Water significa agua.

clueEn: A white nutritious drink produced by cows.
instructionEs: Bebida blanca producida por las vacas.
explanationEn: Milk is a white dairy beverage.
explanationEs: Milk significa leche.

clueEn: A set of printed pages bound together to read.
instructionEs: Hojas impresas encuadernadas para leer.
explanationEn: A book is read for knowledge or entertainment.
explanationEs: Book significa libro.

clueEn: An instrument with ink used for writing.
instructionEs: Instrumento con tinta para escribir.
explanationEn: A pen writes with ink.
explanationEs: Pen significa bolígrafo.

clueEn: A table used in school or an office for studying or working.
instructionEs: Mesa de estudio o trabajo en la escuela u oficina.
explanationEn: A desk is a work table.
explanationEs: Desk significa escritorio o pupitre.

clueEn: A person whose job is to instruct students in a school.
instructionEs: Persona que enseña a los estudiantes.
explanationEn: A teacher educates pupils.
explanationEs: Teacher significa maestro o profesor.

clueEn: A person who is studying at school or university.
instructionEs: Persona que asiste a clases y aprende.
explanationEn: A student attends educational classes.
explanationEs: Student significa estudiante o alumno.

clueEn: A movable barrier used to open and close an entrance.
instructionEs: Barrera móvil para entrar a una habitación.
explanationEn: A door provides entry into a room.
explanationEs: Door significa puerta.

clueEn: An opening in a wall with glass to let in light and air.
instructionEs: Abertura con cristal para dar luz y aire.
explanationEn: A window lets sunlight through.
explanationEs: Window significa ventana.

clueEn: A piece of furniture where you sleep at night.
instructionEs: Mueble donde duermes por la noche.
explanationEn: A bed is used for sleeping.
explanationEs: Bed significa cama.

clueEn: The sensory organ of sight in humans and animals.
instructionEs: El órgano de la vista.
explanationEn: Eyes allow vision.
explanationEs: Eye significa ojo.

clueEn: The end part of the arm with fingers and a thumb.
instructionEs: Parte del brazo con cinco dedos.
explanationEn: Hands hold and manipulate objects.
explanationEs: Hand significa mano.

clueEn: The lower part of the leg that touches the ground when walking.
instructionEs: Parte inferior de la pierna que toca el suelo.
explanationEn: Feet are used for standing and walking.
explanationEs: Foot significa pie.

clueEn: The first meal eaten in the morning.
instructionEs: La primera comida de la mañana.
explanationEn: Breakfast breaks the overnight fast.
explanationEs: Breakfast significa desayuno.

clueEn: A medical professional licensed to treat sick people.
instructionEs: Profesional de la medicina que atiende enfermos.
explanationEn: Doctors diagnose and cure illnesses.
explanationEs: Doctor significa médico o doctor.

clueEn: A facility where airplanes take off, land, and passengers board.
instructionEs: Lugar donde despegan y aterrizan los aviones.
explanationEn: Airports handle flights and airplanes.
explanationEs: Airport significa aeropuerto.

clueEn: A large self-service grocery store selling food and household goods.
instructionEs: Tienda grande de autoservicio de comida y hogar.
explanationEn: Supermarkets sell groceries and household items.
explanationEs: Supermarket significa supermercado.

clueEn: Past tense of 'go': Yesterday I ___ to the cinema.
instructionEs: Pasado del verbo ir (go).
explanationEn: 'Went' is the irregular past tense of 'go'.
explanationEs: Went es el pasado irregular de go.

clueEn: Past tense of 'buy': She ___ a new jacket last weekend.
instructionEs: Pasado del verbo comprar (buy).
explanationEn: 'Bought' is the irregular past of 'buy'.
explanationEs: Bought es el pasado irregular de buy.

clueEn: Comparative form: An elephant is ___ than a mouse.
instructionEs: Forma comparativa de big: más grande que.
explanationEn: Short adjectives take -er, doubling the consonant: bigger.
explanationEs: Big duplica la consonante y añade -er: bigger.

clueEn: Comparative form: Giraffes are ___ than horses.
instructionEs: Más alto que (comparativo de tall).
explanationEn: Comparative of 'tall' is 'taller'.
explanationEs: El comparativo de tall es taller.

clueEn: An institution providing medical treatment and nursing care for patients.
instructionEs: Edificio donde atienden a personas enfermas o heridas.
explanationEn: A hospital provides health care.
explanationEs: Hospital significa hospital.

clueEn: Atmospheric conditions such as temperature, rain, or sunshine.
instructionEs: El estado de la atmósfera: sol, lluvia, frío.
explanationEn: Weather describes daily atmospheric state.
explanationEs: Weather significa clima o tiempo meteorológico.

clueEn: Phrasal verb: To stop trying or abandon a habit or goal.
instructionEs: Verbo compuesto: rendirse o dejar de hacer algo.
explanationEn: 'Give up' means to cease an effort or surrender.
explanationEs: 'Give up' significa rendirse o abandonar un hábito.

clueEn: Phrasal verb: To take care of someone or something.
instructionEs: Cuidar de alguien o algo.
explanationEn: 'Look after' means to protect or care for.
explanationEs: 'Look after' significa cuidar o atender.

clueEn: Phrasal verb: To postpone an event or meeting to a later date.
instructionEs: Posponer o aplazar una reunión o cita.
explanationEn: 'Put off' means to delay or postpone.
explanationEs: 'Put off' significa posponer o aplazar (patrón 3, 3).

clueEn: Phrasal verb: To activate or start an electrical appliance.
instructionEs: Encender un aparato eléctrico.
explanationEn: 'Turn on' means to switch power on.
explanationEs: 'Turn on' significa encender o conectar.

clueEn: Second conditional: If I won the lottery, I ___ travel the world.
instructionEs: Estructura del segundo condicional con if + pasado simple.
explanationEn: Second conditional uses 'would + infinitive' in the result clause.
explanationEs: El segundo condicional usa 'would + infinitivo'.

clueEn: Time preposition: She has lived here ___ 2015.
instructionEs: Preposición para un punto específico en el pasado con Present Perfect.
explanationEn: 'Since' denotes a specific starting point in time.
explanationEs: 'Since' indica el punto de inicio específico (desde).

clueEn: Duration: He has studied English ___ five years.
instructionEs: Preposición que indica duración o periodo de tiempo.
explanationEn: 'For' indicates the length or duration of time.
explanationEs: 'For' expresa duración (durante / desde hace).

clueEn: An arrangement to meet someone at a specific time and place.
instructionEs: Cita programada con un médico, profesional o colega.
explanationEn: An appointment is a scheduled official meeting.
explanationEs: Appointment significa cita concertada.

clueEn: Harmful substances or waste contaminating air, water, or land.
instructionEs: Contaminación ambiental de aire, agua o suelo.
explanationEn: Pollution damages ecosystems.
explanationEs: Pollution significa contaminación.

clueEn: Feeling sad because expectations or hopes were not fulfilled.
instructionEs: Sentirse decepcionado o frustrado.
explanationEn: Disappointed describes feeling let down.
explanationEs: Disappointed significa decepcionado.

clueEn: Collocation: To fail to appreciate someone or something because you are so used to them.
instructionEs: Dar por sentado o no valorar algo por costumbre.
explanationEn: 'Take for granted' means assuming something without gratitude.
explanationEs: 'Take for granted' significa dar por sentado.

clueEn: Collocation: To listen or watch carefully.
instructionEs: Prestar atención atentamente.
explanationEn: We 'pay' attention in English, not make it.
explanationEs: En inglés se dice 'pay attention' (prestar atención).

clueEn: Collocation: To try hard to accomplish something challenging.
instructionEs: Hacer un esfuerzo.
explanationEn: The standard verb collocation is 'make an effort'.
explanationEs: La colocación correcta es 'make an effort'.

clueEn: Phrasal verb: To use up all of a supply so that none is left.
instructionEs: Quedarse sin algo (gasolina, tiempo, dinero).
explanationEn: 'Run out of' means exhausting a supply.
explanationEs: 'Run out of' significa agotar o quedarse sin algo.

clueEn: Passive voice: The telephone ___ by Alexander Graham Bell in 1876.
instructionEs: Voz pasiva en pasado simple.
explanationEn: Singular passive in past: 'was' + past participle.
explanationEs: Pasiva en pasado simple: was invented.

clueEn: Past perfect: By the time we arrived, the train ___.
instructionEs: Pasado perfecto para una acción anterior a otra en el pasado.
explanationEn: Past perfect expresses an action completed before another past event.
explanationEs: Past perfect (had left) indica anterioridad en el pasado.

clueEn: Verb: To cause severe shock, grief, or widespread destruction.
instructionEs: Devastar o arruinar por completo (9 letras).
explanationEn: Devastate has 9 letters and means to overwhelm or ruin.
explanationEs: Devastate (9 letras) significa devastar o arruinar.

clueEn: Modal deduction: She didn't sleep at all; she ___ exhausted.
instructionEs: Deducción lógica sobre el pasado (debe haber estado).
explanationEn: 'Must have been' expresses strong logical certainty about the past.
explanationEs: 'Must have been' expresa certeza lógica sobre el pasado.

clueEn: Idiom: To face a grim or difficult situation with fortitude.
instructionEs: Hacer de tripas corazón / afrontar una situación difícil con valor.
explanationEn: 'Bite the bullet' means enduring something painful unavoidably.
explanationEs: 'Bite the bullet' significa apretar los dientes y afrontar lo inevitable.

clueEn: Adjective: Never having happened, existed, or been experienced before.
instructionEs: Sin precedentes o nunca antes visto.
explanationEn: Unprecedented means without prior occurrence or parallel.
explanationEs: Unprecedented significa sin precedentes.

clueEn: Discourse connector: In spite of that; however.
instructionEs: No obstante, sin embargo.
explanationEn: Nevertheless introduces a contrast or concession.
explanationEs: Nevertheless significa no obstante / a pesar de ello.

clueEn: Conjunction: Even though or although (formal/literary).
instructionEs: Aunque, si bien (formal).
explanationEn: Albeit means 'although' and introduces concessions.
explanationEs: Albeit es una conjunción formal equivalente a aunque o si bien.

clueEn: Inversion: ___ about the delay, I would not have arrived so early.
instructionEs: Inversión formal del tercer condicional en vez de 'If I had known'.
explanationEn: Formal third conditional inversion replaces 'If I had known' with 'Had I known'.
explanationEs: Inversión formal: 'Had I known' sustituye a 'If I had known'.

clueEn: Negative inversion: Seldom ___ seen such a brilliant performance.
instructionEs: Inversión tras adverbio negativo (Seldom / Rarely).
explanationEn: Negative adverbs like 'seldom' at the clause start trigger subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanationEs: Adverbios negativos como seldom exigen inversión: 'have I'.

clueEn: Idiom: To state the exact truth or find the precise answer.
instructionEs: Dar en el clavo.
answer: HIT THE NAIL ON THE HEAD
acceptedAnswers: HIT THE NAIL ON THE HEAD
hit the nail on the head

options.text: HIT THE NAIL ON THE HEAD

explanationEn: 'Hit the nail on the head' means pinpointing the exact issue.
explanationEs: 'Hit the nail on the head' significa dar exactamente en el clavo.

clueEn: Idiom: To perceive a concealed or implied meaning not explicitly stated.
instructionEs: Leer entre líneas o captar el sentido implícito.
explanationEn: To read between the lines is to uncover underlying intentions.
explanationEs: Read between the lines significa descubrir lo que no se dice explícitamente.

clueEn: Adjective: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
instructionEs: Meticuloso, detallista y sumamente preciso.
explanationEn: Meticulous implies thorough precision and care.
explanationEs: Meticulous significa minucioso o meticuloso.

clueEn: Adjective: Present, appearing, or found everywhere simultaneously.
instructionEs: Ubicuo o que está presente en todas partes.
explanationEn: Ubiquitous describes omnipresent phenomena.
explanationEs: Ubiquitous significa omnipresente o ubicuo.

clueEn: Verb: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
instructionEs: Exacerbar, empeorar o agravar una situación.
explanationEn: Exacerbate means to aggravate an existing crisis.
explanationEs: Exacerbate significa agravar o empeorar.

clueEn: Adjective: Very attentive to accuracy and details; hard to please.
instructionEs: Exigente, puntilloso o sumamente escrupuloso.
explanationEn: Fastidious indicates demanding exactitude.
explanationEs: Fastidious significa sumamente detallista y exigente.

clueEn: Adjective: Lasting for a very short, fleeting period of time.
instructionEs: Efímero, fugaz o pasajero.
explanationEn: Ephemeral describes fleeting, short-lived beauty or existence.
explanationEs: Ephemeral alude a lo que es transitorio o efímero.

clueEn: Adjective: Kept secret, especially because it would not be approved of.
instructionEs: Subrepticio, furtivo o realizado a escondidas.
explanationEn: Surreptitious means clandestine or stealthily executed.
explanationEs: Surreptitious significa subrepticio o hecho a escondidas.

clueEn: Adjective: Having a ready insight into and deep understanding of things.
instructionEs: Perspicaz, con agudo entendimiento.
explanationEn: Perspicacious refers to acute discernment.
explanationEs: Perspicacious significa perspicaz o de mente penetrante.

clueEn: Adjective: Representing the most perfect or typical example of a quality.
instructionEs: Por excelencia o que representa la pura esencia.
explanationEn: Quintessential represents the absolute purest archetype.
explanationEs: Quintessential significa el arquetipo o ejemplo por excelencia.

clueEn: Idiomatic prepositional phrase: Because of or on the grounds of.
instructionEs: En virtud de o debido a.
explanationEn: 'By virtue of' denotes operating on the authority or merit of.
explanationEs: 'By virtue of' significa en virtud de.

clueEn: Idiom: To gain an advantage over someone by acting before they do.
instructionEs: Tomar la delantera o adelantarse sigilosamente a un rival.
explanationEn: To steal a march on someone is to outflank them stealthily.
explanationEs: Steal a march on significa adelantarse con astucia.

clueEn: Preposition/Adverb: In spite of; regardless of.
instructionEs: A pesar de, no obstante.
explanationEn: Notwithstanding indicates concession or resilience against odds.
explanationEs: Notwithstanding significa no obstante o a pesar de.

clueEn: Noun: Unpleasant changes of fortune or circumstances.
instructionEs: Altibajos o vicisitudes imprevistas de la vida.
explanationEn: Vicissitudes refer to shifting fortunes and twists of life.
explanationEs: Vicissitudes son las vicisitudes o altibajos.

clueEn: Adjective: Obedient or attentive to an excessive or servile degree.
instructionEs: Servil, zalamero o excesivamente sumiso.
explanationEn: Obsequious describes fawning or servile sycophancy.
explanationEs: Obsequious significa zalamero o servil.

clueEn: Noun: Great physical beauty and aesthetic grace (literary).
instructionEs: Pulcritud en sentido clásico literario: gran belleza física.
explanationEn: Pulchritude is an erudite noun for physical beauty.
explanationEs: Pulchritude significa belleza física sublime en registro literario.

clueEn: The number after zero and before two.
instructionEs: El número 1.
explanationEn: 'ONE' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'ONE' significa 'El número 1.'.

clueEn: The number of eyes or hands a human has.
instructionEs: El número 2.
explanationEn: 'TWO' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'TWO' significa 'El número 2.'.

clueEn: The number of sides a triangle has.
instructionEs: El número 3.
explanationEn: 'THREE' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'THREE' significa 'El número 3.'.

clueEn: The number of legs a dog or cat has.
instructionEs: El número 4.
explanationEn: 'FOUR' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'FOUR' significa 'El número 4.'.

clueEn: The number of fingers on one hand.
instructionEs: El número 5.
explanationEn: 'FIVE' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'FIVE' significa 'El número 5.'.

clueEn: Half of a dozen.
instructionEs: El número 6.
explanationEn: 'SIX' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'SIX' significa 'El número 6.'.

clueEn: The number of days in one week.
instructionEs: El número de días en una semana.
explanationEn: 'SEVEN' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'SEVEN' significa 'El número de días en una semana.'.

clueEn: The number of legs an octopus or spider has.
instructionEs: El número 8.
explanationEn: 'EIGHT' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'EIGHT' significa 'El número 8.'.

clueEn: The number that comes right before ten.
instructionEs: El número 9.
explanationEn: 'NINE' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'NINE' significa 'El número 9.'.

clueEn: The total number of digits on both hands.
instructionEs: El número 10.
explanationEn: 'TEN' is key vocabulary in Numbers.
explanationEs: 'TEN' significa 'El número 10.'.

clueEn: The first day of the traditional working week.
instructionEs: El primer día de la semana laboral.
explanationEn: 'MONDAY' is key vocabulary in Daily Life.
explanationEs: 'MONDAY' significa 'El primer día de la semana laboral.'.

clueEn: The second day of the week, following Monday.
instructionEs: El día después del lunes.
explanationEn: 'TUESDAY' is key vocabulary in Daily Life.
explanationEs: 'TUESDAY' significa 'El día después del lunes.'.

clueEn: The middle day of the traditional work week.
instructionEs: El miércoles.
explanationEn: 'WEDNESDAY' is key vocabulary in Daily Life.
explanationEs: 'WEDNESDAY' significa 'El miércoles.'.

clueEn: The day between Wednesday and Friday.
instructionEs: El día entre el miércoles y el viernes.
explanationEn: 'THURSDAY' is key vocabulary in Daily Life.
explanationEs: 'THURSDAY' significa 'El día entre el miércoles y el viernes.'.

clueEn: The last day of the standard working week.
instructionEs: El último día laborable antes del fin de semana.
explanationEn: 'FRIDAY' is key vocabulary in Daily Life.
explanationEs: 'FRIDAY' significa 'El último día laborable antes del fin de semana.'.

clueEn: The first day of the weekend.
instructionEs: El primer día del fin de semana.
explanationEn: 'SATURDAY' is key vocabulary in Daily Life.
explanationEs: 'SATURDAY' significa 'El primer día del fin de semana.'.

clueEn: The closing day of the week, traditionally for rest.
instructionEs: El domingo, día de descanso.
explanationEn: 'SUNDAY' is key vocabulary in Daily Life.
explanationEs: 'SUNDAY' significa 'El domingo, día de descanso.'.

clueEn: Small white or brown grains eaten widely across the world.
instructionEs: Granos blancos o marrones básicos en la alimentación.
explanationEn: 'RICE' is key vocabulary in Food & Drink.
explanationEs: 'RICE' significa 'Granos blancos o marrones básicos en la alimentación.'.

clueEn: An oval object laid by chickens, with a yolk inside.
instructionEs: Huevo puesto por las gallinas.
explanationEn: 'EGG' is key vocabulary in Food & Drink.
explanationEs: 'EGG' significa 'Huevo puesto por las gallinas.'.

clueEn: A yellow or white dairy food made from pressed curds.
instructionEs: Alimento lácteo sólido amarillo o blanco.
explanationEn: 'CHEESE' is key vocabulary in Food & Drink.
explanationEs: 'CHEESE' significa 'Alimento lácteo sólido amarillo o blanco.'.

clueEn: A baked flat dough topped with tomato sauce and melted cheese.
instructionEs: Masa horneada con salsa de tomate y queso fundido.
explanationEn: 'PIZZA' is key vocabulary in Food & Drink.
explanationEs: 'PIZZA' significa 'Masa horneada con salsa de tomate y queso fundido.'.
